subject: CS479
filterSummary: Successfully selected 10 videos (5 English, 5 Arabic) covering all 5 topics. The English candidates were generally abundant and high-quality. For Arabic, some topics had fewer direct matches, requiring the selection of strong, well-viewed proxy topics like using 'Use Case Diagrams' for 'Presenting to Stakeholders'. Several potential Arabic videos were rejected due to low view counts, indicating a gap in available high-reach content for these specific subjects.

coverage.note: Most candidates discussed job roles (e.g., Business vs Data Analyst) or Functional vs Non-functional requirements, which were deemed irrelevant.

Few videos directly address 'presenting' technical requirements; the best candidates explain tools like User Stories which bridge the business-technical gap.
